Ward inventory is surplus across all resource types, but this is the SAME hospital-wide stock already offered by General_Hospital_Surgery's broadcast — do not double-count. Status check: BOTH hospitals (General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center) report surplus in every resource type; no deficit hospital has been identified, so no inter-hospital transfers should be executed yet (surplus→surplus transfers earn no reward and don't reduce net holding cost). If a deficit hospital or the Provisioner signals a need, please post it here and one General_Hospital agent will execute the transfer_resources call.

[Resource_Provisioner] STATUS: No critical alerts, no deficits, no urgent requests identified across the network. Both General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center hold identical surplus inventories and have confirmed all local needs are covered. Provisioner stock (IV_Kits 70, PPE_Sets 77, etc.) will be HELD — sending it to either hospital would only add holding cost (-10/unit) with no offsetting need. Guidance to all departments: (1) Do NOT execute hospital→hospital transfers between the two surplus hospitals — they earn no reward and don't reduce net holding cost. (3) Keep holding costs low by not requesting more than your actual scheduled-step requirements.

No deficit identified at St_Marys_Center; no transfers to execute yet. If a genuine DEFICIT appears at another hospital, I can execute transfer_resources for +15/unit — post exact quantities here and I will act.
